preregistration.criterion_verbatim: The word 'first-order' is licensed iff the position-wise i.i.d. null loses to the first-order Markov model by BIC for a strict majority of services at k=30 and at every tested prefix length k=2..30; if the position-wise null wins or ties at any tested prefix length, the word 'first-order' is not licensed.

models.global_iid: Imported exact fit_nested_models: one Bernoulli p over all positions.
models.positionwise_iid: Independent Bernoulli positions with one MLE and one BIC parameter per position.
models.first_order_markov: Imported exact fit_nested_models: initial Bernoulli plus two transition rates.
models.bic_convention: BIC = -2 log(L) + d log(N), with N equal to all bits in the tested prefix.

outcome.plain_statement: NOT LICENSED: the position-wise i.i.d. null wins or ties at one or more tested k.
